# Mimo

> Live transcription, rolling notes, and meeting questions for macOS.

Mimo is a free, open-source native macOS application for dictation and meeting transcription. Core speech recognition can run locally on Apple silicon. Optional hosted providers are used only when selected and configured.

## Features

- **Dictation**: Hold the configured hotkey to speak and paste text at the cursor.
- **Meetings**: Record microphone and system audio into a timestamped transcript.
- **Bilingual meetings**: Transcribe Chinese and English as speakers switch languages; present summaries and assistant answers in English.
- **Live assistance**: Maintain a rolling brief and ask questions about the recorded conversation.
- **Reviewed meetings**: SenseVoice Small supplies live Chinese-English text. After Stop, the selected Whisper model transcribes the complete recording; a comparison with the live draft informs English minutes and flags unresolved details.
- **Local models**: Reviewed meetings default to full Whisper Large v3 for the final pass. Whisper Large Turbo is a faster, smaller alternative. Both SenseVoice and the chosen final model must be downloaded before recording.
- **Summaries**: Choose a local model, ChatGPT sign-in, or a supported hosted provider.
- **Imports and exports**: Transcribe existing recordings and export meeting notes.

## Platform and storage

- Native Swift, AppKit, and SwiftUI on macOS 14.2 or later, Apple silicon.
- Installed application: /Applications/Mimo.app
- Local app data: ~/Library/Application Support/Mimo/
- Local transcription models run through FluidAudio, Core ML, WhisperKit, and other supported on-device backends.
- Model details distinguish supported languages from tested language mixing, with local chip, RAM, and free-storage guidance. Download size is separate from runtime memory.
- Hosted dictation can send audio to the selected provider; hosted summaries and cleanup send the text needed for that request. Local features remain available offline after their models are downloaded.
